messages:
Maya Lin: Quick thread — tech check in 12 for today's all-hands. Two agenda tweaks + recording edge-case to note.
Ethan Brooks: I'll be in the green room for checks. What are the agenda tweaks?
Maya Lin: Shift roadmap 8m earlier, extend Q&A by 10m. Also flagging an EDID negotiation flake we saw yesterday with Presenter Dell laptops.
Kai (AV): Noted. Workaround: force 1080p60 on the encoder if EDID fails, and plug into DP input instead of HDMI.
Kai (AV): Quick command to force encoder mode if we hit a black-screen loop:
```
# force 1080p60 mode and restart
echo "video_mode=1080p60" > /etc/stream/video_mode.conf && systemctl restart stream-encoder
```
Sam - Comms: I'll update the calendar and pin the new agenda. Also prepping a 2-slide summary for leadership Qs.
Rosa - Product: Pre-submitted Q: how will Dedicated burst billing be shown in invoices? per-second, per-minute, or as a daily bucket?
Maya Lin: We'll ask Ops/Product on stage; if unclear we'll publish concrete billing examples in the follow-up doc.
Ibrahim - Security: One compliance Q to surface: can Private do rolling HSM key rotation with zero interruption for active sessions? Need to confirm for SOC.
Lena - EngPD: Also a request: leaders please mention whether Optimize suggestions will show estimated token-cost deltas in the Console. We have customers asking.
Maya Lin: Got it — we'll prioritize Dedicated SLAs, HSM rotation, then Optimize cost deltas during Q&A. Drop written Qs here and we'll pull top-voted ones.
OpsBot: :warning: Roomb battery low (22%) — Kai please swap to spare pack before go-live.
Kai (AV): Swapped. Also bringing 4 spare HDMI, 2 DP, 3 lavs. Doing a quick audio loop test now. Levels -6dB peak.
Sam - Comms: If the recording fails, plan is: 1) publish transcript + slides within 90m, 2) if video can be recovered we'll append it later.
Ethan Brooks: During rehearsal the lectern mic auto-muted after 18s of low level. Can we disable timeout?
Kai (AV): I'll disable the auto-mute for the event window. Command: `systemctl stop mic-autosleep && logger "autosleep disabled for event"`.
OpsBot: :recording: Recording scheduled to start at 17:00 UTC. Auto-archive to /shared/all-hands/2026-11-04/.
Maya Lin: Thanks — tech check in 8. If anyone else has last-minute asks, drop them here rather than DMs. :thumbsup:
